🍂The Turning🍂

✶The Ledger✶

National Grid electric bills this winter
+3–5%
National Grid expects typical residential electric customers to pay 3 to 5 percent more this winter. Gas customers could see a slight decrease.

✶The National Wire✶

1

Update: Pope Leo Going Home

The Vatican says Pope Leo XIV will be discharged from the hospital today, four days after surgeons removed part of his right lung. Photos released Friday showed him celebrating Mass in the hospital.

2

Press Secretary Out After Five Days

Katie Zacharia is out as White House press secretary after five days on the job. She had confirmed earlier this week that she never passed the bar exam.

3

Wind-Driven Fires in California

Santa Ana winds are driving fires through Southern California, burning coastal homes and forcing thousands to evacuate. The fast-moving Norte Fire is one of 13 burning across the state.

4

Musk Shows a Flying Tesla

Elon Musk unveiled a Tesla prototype with thrusters that can do aerial acrobatics, in front of a cheering crowd in Texas. It is not approved for sale or for the road.

☑ The Ballot · 17 days to Election Day · early voting opens a week from today, Oct 24, the same day registration closes · every race: benthambulletin.github.io/election

⛪The Home Wire⛪

1

Rochester · Bill Nye at RIT

Bill Nye the Science Guy is back in Rochester as the guest speaker for RIT's homecoming, Brick City Weekend. He is best known for his Emmy-winning TV series.

2

Chautauqua County · Most Seats Contested

Thirteen of the county's 19 legislative districts have contested races in November. That is about two-thirds of the county Legislature, by the Observer's count.

3

Niagara Falls · A Gondola Over the Falls?

A Niagara Falls student at the University at Buffalo is presenting a proposal for a gondola to view the falls from above. The city already has plenty of viewpoints; this would add one in the air.

★The Marquee★

1

Miley Sings "Jolene"

Miley Cyrus played her first "Bass Persuades" show at the Hollywood Bowl and gave a tearful "Jolene" in tribute to Dolly Parton. "Me and Dolly, we are eternal," she told the crowd.

2

Harry Styles Remembers Liam Payne

Styles premiered an unreleased song, "What Is Enough," on the second anniversary of his former One Direction bandmate's death. Payne died in a fall from a hotel balcony in Buenos Aires in 2024; he was 31.

3

Elizabeth Holmes Doc Draws a Crowd

You Can See Everything, a documentary about the Theranos founder, is headed for about $12 million in its opening weekend, the second-best start ever for a documentary. Holmes's partner, Billy Evans, defended making the film: "Make up your own mind."

🏈The Gridiron🏈

Tomorrow: 1:00 and 4:25
Jets · At New England, 1:00. The Jets are 2–3 after beating Cleveland 17–12 last Sunday, and a win pulls them even with the 3–2 Patriots in the division.
Bills · At Las Vegas, 4:25. Buffalo is 4–1 after outlasting the Rams 37–34 in overtime Monday night; the Raiders are 3–2.

⚑The Chase⚑

Tomorrow at Phoenix
Ryan Blaney has won the last two Cup races at Phoenix and sits fifth, 85 points back. Larson leads, Hamlin, Bell and Briscoe chase, and the green flag drops at 3 p.m. on USA.

☾On This Day☾

October 17, 1989 — A magnitude 6.9 earthquake hit the San Francisco Bay Area minutes before Game 3 of the World Series between the Giants and A's at Candlestick Park. The game was postponed for ten days.
